title: iHeartMedia Celebrates New Music from Brothers Osborne ft. Cody Johnson, Dorinda Clark-Cole, The Smashing Pumpkins, Tate McRae, Staind, Gunna and BigXThaPlug ft. Ava Max
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK – October 23, 2026** – iHeartMedia highlighted new music and artists alike recently with special programming.


Today, iHeartCountry celebrated **Brothers Osborne’s** latest release[“Born and Raised Hell”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/brothers-osborne-930485/songs/born-and-raised-hell-441136638) ft. Cody Johnson, with a World Premiere of the new track across iHeartCountry stations nationwide. Yesterday, iHeartMedia World Premiered **Dorinda Clark-Cole’s** new single["Better Than This"](https://www.iheart.com/artist/dorinda-clark-cole-117553) across iHeartRadio Gospel stations.


Earlier in October, iHeartMedia highlighted new music with World Premieres including **The Smashing Pumpkins’**[“Black Stars”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/smashing-pumpkins-29249/songs/black-stars-439413969) on October 16 on iHeartRadio Alt and Rock stations, **Tate McRae’s**[“Housewife”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/tate-mcrae-31522919/songs/housewife-440475016) on October 16 across iHeartRadio CHR stations, **Staind’s**[“Ghosts”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/staind-58118/albums/ghosts-439135747) on October 14 on iHeartRadio Rock and Alt stations, **Gunna’s**[“pop it”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/gunna-30193508/songs/pop-it-437994543) on iHeartRadio Hip Hop stations on October 9.


Additionally, on October 9 **BigXThaPlug ft. Ava Max** new track[“BURN”](https://www.iheart.com/artist/bigxthaplug-33485189/songs/burn-feat-ava-max-436948679) was featured in New Music Friday slots across iHeartRadio Rhythmic CHR stations.
